column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 07 (M23007): gelombang serangan pertama, Igla menembus benteng.
# Tetap Inggris: Mokosh, Mangi Security, Oathguards, Squad 404, Monsoon Squad, Doll,
# Igla, Klukai, Mechty, Belka, Andoris, Cheyanne, Zhaohui, Wulfgar, Vasily, Dome.
(On the skyline of Mokosh's outer urban area, Mangi Security's heavy drone swarm was quietly approaching under the cover of optical camouflage.)
column2: (Di garis langit kawasan kota luar Mokosh, kawanan drone berat Mangi Security mendekat diam-diam di balik kamuflase optik.)

column1: (Mounted under their bellies were heavy bunker-buster bombs born specifically to destroy sturdy underground fortresses, aiming directly at Mokosh's core facilities.)
column2: (Terpasang di perut mereka bom penembus bunker berat yang lahir khusus untuk menghancurkan benteng bawah tanah yang kokoh, membidik langsung fasilitas inti Mokosh.)

column1: (But this layer of disguise did not work. Before the swarm could reach the bombing coordinates, Mokosh's close-in weapon system suddenly opened fire. The deadly tongues of fire spat out by the close-in defense weapon system wove into an airtight fire net in the sky, instantly igniting clusters of gorgeous fireworks.)
column2: (Tapi lapisan samaran itu tak berguna. Sebelum kawanan itu mencapai koordinat pengeboman, sistem senjata jarak dekat Mokosh tiba-tiba membuka tembakan. Lidah api mematikan yang dimuntahkan sistem pertahanan jarak dekat itu menganyam jaring tembak yang rapat di langit, seketika menyulut gugusan kembang api yang megah.)

column1: (Guiding this anti-aircraft counterattack was a petite Doll operating a complex observation system. Her visual module was zooming and analyzing at an extremely high frequency, leaving all stealth targets in the sky with nowhere to hide.)
column2: (Yang memandu serangan balik anti-pesawat ini adalah seorang Doll mungil yang mengoperasikan sistem pengamatan rumit. Modul penglihatannya memperbesar dan menganalisis pada frekuensi sangat tinggi, membuat semua sasaran siluman di langit tak punya tempat sembunyi.)

column1: All enemy concealed targets have been marked and destroyed. The current airspace threat is lifted, I am preparing to transfer positions.
column2: Seluruh sasaran tersembunyi musuh sudah ditandai dan dihancurkan. Ancaman wilayah udara saat ini sudah hilang, saya bersiap berpindah posisi.

column1: (The failure of the optical drones did not deter the enemy's command. In order to destroy the close-in fire net built by Mokosh, the armored troops approached first, attempting to forcibly clear all fortifications.)
column2: (Gagalnya drone optik tidak menyurutkan komando musuh. Demi menghancurkan jaring tembak jarak dekat yang dibangun Mokosh, pasukan lapis baja maju lebih dulu, berusaha membabat paksa semua benteng.)

column1: Confirmed enemy heavy armor targets approaching, will officially make contact with the defense line after 0012.
column2: Terkonfirmasi sasaran lapis baja berat musuh mendekat, akan resmi bersentuhan dengan garis pertahanan setelah 0012.

column1: (Mangi Security's armored vehicles took the lead in crashing through the roadblocks on the main road, preparing to drive straight in and quickly take down more urban areas under infantry-tank coordination.)
column2: (Kendaraan lapis baja Mangi Security memimpin menerjang penghalang jalan di jalur utama, bersiap melaju lurus dan cepat merebut lebih banyak kawasan kota lewat koordinasi infanteri-tank.)

column1: (However, at the same time as crashing through the first roadblock, a violent explosion sounded.)
column2: (Namun, bersamaan dengan menerjang penghalang pertama, ledakan dahsyat menggelegar.)

column1: Confirmed anti-tank mines are effective, coordinates transmission complete.
column2: Terkonfirmasi ranjau anti-tank efektif, pengiriman koordinat selesai.

column1: Understood. All Squad 404 teams, Monsoon Squad, act according to the original plan!
column2: Dimengerti. Seluruh tim Squad 404, Monsoon Squad, bergerak sesuai rencana awal!

column1: (Anti-tank and anti-personnel mines successfully hindered the enemy's attack route, and the street fighting centered around the outskirts of Mokosh officially began.)
column2: (Ranjau anti-tank dan anti-personel berhasil menghambat rute serangan musuh, dan pertempuran jalanan yang berpusat di pinggiran Mokosh resmi dimulai.)

column1: (Various heavy firepower from Mokosh covered the enemy's formation completely regardless of consumption. It caused a slight delay in the enemy's offensive pace.)
column2: (Berbagai daya tembak berat Mokosh menghujani formasi musuh tanpa peduli pemborosan amunisi. Itu sedikit memperlambat laju serangan musuh.)

column1: (Relying on fire cover, with Dolls as the frontal breakthrough, the Oathguards roamed and harassed to cooperate with each other. The enemy formation, which was already a bit chaotic, immediately experienced greater turmoil.)
column2: (Bertumpu pada perlindungan tembakan, dengan Doll sebagai penerobos depan, Oathguards berkeliling mengganggu untuk saling mendukung. Formasi musuh yang sudah agak kacau langsung makin porak-poranda.)

column1: (But the enemy quickly took countermeasures. They swiftly used the cover of the tactical drone swarm to retreat the chaotic troops, and immediately guided artillery to counterattack, attempting to conduct precise point removals on Mokosh's exposed heavy fire net and the Oathguards' defensive positions.)
column2: (Tapi musuh cepat mengambil tindakan balasan. Mereka gesit memakai perlindungan kawanan drone taktis untuk menarik mundur pasukan yang kacau, dan langsung memandu artileri membalas, berusaha menghabisi titik demi titik jaring tembak berat Mokosh yang terekspos dan posisi pertahanan Oathguards.)

column1: (The roar of artillery resounded through the battlefield, however, the Oathguards adhered to my guerrilla tactics. They must evacuate immediately within 1 minute after firing the first shot.)
column2: (Deru artileri menggema di medan tempur, namun Oathguards berpegang pada taktik gerilyaku. Mereka harus segera menyingkir dalam 1 menit setelah melepas tembakan pertama.)

column1: Sir, the assault troops have retreated back into formation, and the enemy's offensive is easing.
column2: Pak, pasukan penyerbu sudah ditarik kembali ke formasi, dan serangan musuh mengendur.

column1: It seems we have withstood the first wave of attacks. Vasily, how is the internal situation in Mokosh?
column2: Sepertinya kita bertahan dari gelombang serangan pertama. Vasily, bagaimana situasi di dalam Mokosh?

column1: The internal facilities have not suffered severe impacts for now, and the evacuation of residents is also complete. Only necessary security personnel remain stationed near the military facilities inside the city.
column2: Fasilitas dalam untuk sementara belum terkena dampak parah, dan evakuasi warga juga sudah tuntas. Hanya personel keamanan seperlunya yang tetap berjaga di dekat fasilitas militer dalam kota.

column1: Good. The enemy won't stop their attack so easily, everyone stay alert. Launch our drones and confirm more intel on the enemy as soon as possible.
column2: Bagus. Musuh tidak akan berhenti menyerang semudah itu, semuanya tetap waspada. Terbangkan drone kita dan pastikan lebih banyak informasi musuh secepatnya.

column1: Cheyanne, pay attention to the movements of that entity I mentioned... If anything happens, sync it to Klukai immediately.
column2: Cheyanne, perhatikan gerakan sosok yang kusebut tadi... Kalau ada apa-apa, langsung teruskan ke Klukai.

column1: I will report immediately.
column2: Saya akan segera melapor.

column1: Monsoon Squad, Squad 404, you continue to push forward, try to pin down the enemy, and push the defense line a bit further away from the periphery of Mokosh.
column2: Monsoon Squad, Squad 404, kalian terus maju, coba tahan musuh, dan dorong garis pertahanan sedikit lebih jauh dari pinggiran Mokosh.

column1: Got it.
column2: Siap.

column1: (As the two squads rushed to the combat zone as planned, the communication channel returned to silence again. I brought up the tactical panel and shifted my attention to the peripheral strongholds garrisoned by the Oathguards, as well as the defensive positions damaged in the enemy's first round of artillery fire.)
column2: (Saat kedua regu melesat ke zona tempur sesuai rencana, kanal komunikasi kembali hening. Kubuka panel taktis dan kualihkan perhatianku ke pos-pos pinggiran yang dijaga Oathguards, serta posisi pertahanan yang rusak akibat gempuran artileri musuh yang pertama.)

column1: Wulfgar, mobilize the available Oathguard squads to prioritize repairing this batch of destroyed close-in defense systems.
column2: Wulfgar, kerahkan regu Oathguard yang tersedia untuk memprioritaskan perbaikan sistem pertahanan jarak dekat yang hancur ini.

column1: The enemy won't give us time, I'm afraid they will attack again soon.
column2: Musuh tidak akan memberi kita waktu, kurasa mereka akan menyerang lagi sebentar lagi.

column1: No problem, some of the close-in defense systems are completely written off, and emergency repair work is already underway.
column2: Tidak masalah, sebagian sistem pertahanan jarak dekat sudah tidak bisa diselamatkan, dan perbaikan darurat sudah berjalan.

column1: Sir! Drones show that several squads have broken away from their original formation and started advancing at full speed towards our defense line!
column2: Pak! Drone menunjukkan beberapa regu memisahkan diri dari formasi asalnya dan mulai melaju kecepatan penuh ke garis pertahanan kita!

column1: Is it the second wave of attacks? No, it could also be evacuating to specific positions to besiege Mokosh. If it's a protracted war... Mokosh can hold on, but it's best to have some buffer time—
column2: Apakah ini gelombang serangan kedua? Bukan, bisa juga mereka berpindah ke posisi tertentu untuk mengepung Mokosh. Kalau jadi perang berlarut... Mokosh sanggup bertahan, tapi lebih baik ada waktu jeda—

column1: ...Judging by the speed, it's a mobile force. This movement is trying to pull out our fortifications one by one...
column2: ...Dari kecepatannya, itu pasukan bergerak. Manuver ini berusaha mencabut benteng kita satu per satu...

column1: Monsoon Squad, pin down the enemy's advance speed.
column2: Monsoon Squad, tahan laju maju musuh.

column1: Yes, ma'am!
column2: Siap, Bu!

column1: (With the reconnaissance reports from several drones and Cheyanne, the battlefield situation became increasingly clear—)
column2: (Berkat laporan pengintaian beberapa drone dan Cheyanne, situasi medan tempur makin jelas—)

column1: (As expected, Mangi Security's elite troops did not collapse due to a temporary setback. The second wave of attacks began again, with continuous wave-like assaults, and a large number of drones took to the sky to attack us.)
column2: (Sesuai dugaan, pasukan elite Mangi Security tidak runtuh karena kemunduran sesaat. Gelombang serangan kedua dimulai lagi, dengan serbuan bergelombang tanpa henti, dan banyak drone naik ke udara menyerang kami.)

column1: (And those mobile troops began to impact our close-in fortifications in the form of points. Even though the Monsoon Squad had dispersed as much as possible to pin down more of the opponent's manpower, it was still unstoppable. There were still many elite troops swiftly attacking the fire strongholds scattered around the outskirts of Mokosh.)
column2: (Dan pasukan bergerak itu mulai menghantam benteng jarak dekat kami titik demi titik. Meski Monsoon Squad sudah menyebar semaksimal mungkin untuk menahan lebih banyak tenaga lawan, itu tetap tak terbendung. Masih banyak pasukan elite yang gesit menyerang pos-pos tembak yang tersebar di pinggiran Mokosh.)

column1: That direction is... the fortifications still under repair?!
column2: Arah itu... benteng yang masih dalam perbaikan?!

column1: Wulfgar, the enemy is heading your way! Have the engineering squad retreat!
column2: Wulfgar, musuh menuju ke arahmu! Suruh regu teknik mundur!

column1: Received! We've spotted the enemy.
column2: Diterima! Kami sudah melihat musuhnya.

column1: (Beep-beep-beep...)
column2: (Bip-bip-bip...)

column1: (Wulfgar, located within the outer defense stronghold of Mokosh, was shocked by the enemy attacks shown on the radar. Continuous Doll machines were targetedly attacking the stubbornly resisting strongholds.)
column2: (Wulfgar, yang berada di dalam pos pertahanan luar Mokosh, terkejut melihat serangan musuh di radar. Mesin-mesin Doll bergantian menyerang secara terarah pos-pos yang masih keras bertahan.)

column1: (After realizing that the enemy was adopting a targeted breakthrough strategy, all firepower was concentrated to clear the enemy troops approaching the fire strongholds at the first opportunity.)
column2: (Setelah menyadari musuh memakai strategi terobosan terarah, seluruh daya tembak dipusatkan untuk membersihkan pasukan musuh yang mendekati pos tembak secepat mungkin.)

column1: (But the continuous attacks only briefly delayed the offensive of some enemy troops. There was still a figure that easily broke through the fire net of the fortifications.)
column2: (Tapi serangan bertubi-tubi itu hanya sesaat memperlambat sebagian pasukan musuh. Masih ada satu sosok yang dengan mudah menembus jaring tembak benteng.)

column1: (Whether it was artillery or bullets, they seemed unable to stop that figure in the binoculars.)
column2: (Entah artileri maupun peluru, semuanya seolah tak mampu menghentikan sosok yang tertangkap teropong itu.)

column1: (On the tactical map, a distinct bright spot stood out among the troops that were already advancing at full speed.)
column2: (Di peta taktis, satu titik terang mencolok menonjol di antara pasukan yang sudah melaju kecepatan penuh.)

column1: No, can't hit the enemy! She's charging over here.
column2: Gawat, musuhnya tidak kena! Dia menerjang ke arah sini.

column1: Crossfire! Crossfire! Don't spare the bullets, cover all the enemy's advance routes!
column2: Tembakan silang! Tembakan silang! Jangan irit peluru, tutup semua rute maju musuh!

column1: Quickly cover the engineering squad's evacuation!
column2: Cepat lindungi mundurnya regu teknik!

column1: No, can't hit at all, the attack points around us are still constantly being destroyed!
column2: Gawat, sama sekali tidak kena, titik-titik serang di sekitar kita terus dihancurkan!

column1: This movement trajectory... a monster...
column2: Lintasan gerak ini... monster...

column1: The outer C1 point turret has been completely destroyed, B3 point has suffered heavy damage, preliminary judgment of damage probability is 58%, need to arrange squad rest, C2 point is under attack—
column2: Turret titik C1 luar hancur total, titik B3 rusak berat, perkiraan awal kemungkinan kerusakan 58%, perlu mengatur istirahat regu, titik C2 sedang diserang—

column1: No, although there is only one enemy, our fire coverage hasn't worked at all.
column2: Gawat, meski musuhnya cuma satu, hujan tembakan kita sama sekali tidak mempan.

column1: After shifting the firepower, we have no way to deal with the attacking troops behind the enemy! If this continues, the stronghold... won't be able to hold on!
column2: Setelah daya tembak dialihkan, kita tidak bisa menangani pasukan penyerang di belakang musuh! Kalau begini terus, posnya... tidak akan sanggup bertahan!

column1: Everyone hold on! Reinforcements have arrived!
column2: Semuanya bertahan! Bantuan sudah datang!

column1: (Boom—)
column2: (Buum—)

column1: (A dense barrage of rockets finally forced the Doll, who was moving as if in an uninhabited land, to stop.)
column2: (Hujan roket yang rapat akhirnya memaksa Doll yang bergerak seenaknya bak di tanah tak berpenghuni itu berhenti.)

column1: ...This response speed...
column2: ...Kecepatan respons ini...

column1: Your opponents are us.
column2: Lawanmu adalah kami.

column1: Ugh... third-generation Dolls again...
column2: Ugh... Doll generasi ketiga lagi...

column1: Your operational efficiency far exceeds my calculations.
column2: Efisiensi operasi kalian jauh melampaui perhitunganku.

column1: Why...
column2: Kenapa...

column1: Because we've been waiting for you to show up!
column2: Karena kami sudah menunggumu muncul!

column1: We can't let the squad you lead successfully tear open our defense net.
column2: Kami tidak boleh membiarkan regu yang kaupimpin merobek jaring pertahanan kami.

column1: Stop talking nonsense. Belka, cover us. Mechty, you and I will pin her down together!
column2: Sudah, jangan banyak omong. Belka, lindungi kami. Mechty, kau dan aku tahan dia bersama!

column1: (The roar of the engine, accompanied by a hail of bullets, attacked Igla. Although there was a gap in power, Klukai's motorcycle had made up for the disadvantage in mobility.)
column2: (Deru mesin, disertai hujan peluru, menyerbu Igla. Meski ada selisih kekuatan, motor Klukai menutup kelemahan di sisi kelincahan.)

column1: ...In the way.
column2: ...Menghalangi.

column1: It's not okay!
column2: Tidak boleh!

column1: (The 60-millisecond high-speed three-round burst from the most precise rifle suppressed even third-generation Dolls with its astonishing firepower, forcing them to halt their steps.)
column2: (Rentetan tiga peluru kecepatan tinggi 60 milidetik dari senapan paling presisi itu menekan bahkan Doll generasi ketiga dengan daya tembak yang mencengangkan, memaksa langkah mereka terhenti.)

column1: (And this momentary pause was captured by the already prepared particle cannon.)
column2: (Dan jeda sesaat itu ditangkap oleh meriam partikel yang sudah siap menunggu.)

column1: Sniping...
column2: Sniper...

column1: (Even though Igla had sensed the danger and instinctively dodged the attack, the cluster from the particle cannon still hit her arm.)
column2: (Meski Igla sudah merasakan bahaya dan naluriah mengelak, semburan meriam partikel itu tetap mengenai lengannya.)

column1: (Sensing the enemy's gaze, Andoris left her sniping position and searched for new cover, preparing for a second attack opportunity.)
column2: (Merasakan tatapan musuh, Andoris meninggalkan posisi menembaknya dan mencari perlindungan baru, bersiap untuk kesempatan serangan kedua.)

column1: Eh? I-It's only a light wound?!
column2: Eh? C-Cuma luka ringan?!

column1: Waaah... That's why I hate fighting bosses with such overpowered stats.
column2: Waaah... Makanya aku benci lawan Boss dengan stat seoverpower itu.

column1: Cut the crap!
column2: Sudah, jangan cerewet!

column1: Where is—he?
column2: Di mana—dia?

column1: (Igla's gaze searched around, and after falling on Klukai and Mechty, she spoke lightly.)
column2: (Pandangan Igla menyapu sekeliling, dan setelah jatuh pada Klukai dan Mechty, dia bicara datar.)

column1: Where is the Commander.
column2: Di mana Komandan.

column1: Your mobility and efficiency far exceed my calculations.
column2: Kelincahan dan efisiensi kalian jauh melampaui perhitunganku.

column1: It can only be that person commanding.
column2: Hanya orang itu yang bisa memimpin.

column1: Hand over the Commander, you are not my targets.
column2: Serahkan Komandan, kalian bukan targetku.

column1: You've got to be kidding me!
column2: Yang benar saja!

column1: Such a troublesome battle just to find the Commander?
column2: Pertempuran serepot ini cuma untuk menemukan Komandan?

column1: Besides Klukai who likes to look for the Commander, there are way too many people who want to find the Commander—
column2: Selain Klukai yang hobi mencari Komandan, kebanyakan orang juga mau mencari Komandan—

column1: If you spout any more nonsense, I'll make you execute the combat plan alone!
column2: Kalau kau ngoceh lagi, kusuruh kau jalankan rencana tempurnya sendirian!

column1: Ahhh, I know, I know!
column2: Ahhh, iya iya, aku tahu!

column1: I will find him...
column2: Aku akan menemukannya...

column1: After cleaning you up...
column2: Setelah membereskan kalian...

column1: (And with the assisted aiming from Zhaohui and the other Dolls, the close-in weapon system accurately locked onto all targets. Even with their mobility, the drones found it hard to escape the coverage of the fire net.)
column2: (Dan dengan bantuan pembidikan dari Zhaohui serta para Doll lain, sistem senjata jarak dekat mengunci semua sasaran dengan akurat. Sekalipun lincah, drone-drone itu sulit lolos dari jangkauan jaring tembak.)

column1: (As a result, the enemy's firepower coverage this time did not cause any effective strikes against us.)
column2: (Hasilnya, hujan tembakan musuh kali ini tidak menimbulkan pukulan efektif apa pun terhadap kami.)

column1: (The two Doll squads and Cheyanne can cooperate with each other. Cheyanne will operate the observation system for battlefield coordination, capturing frontline dynamics in real-time, and relaying precise marked information to Monsoon Squad and Squad 404.)
column2: (Kedua regu Doll dan Cheyanne bisa saling mendukung. Cheyanne mengoperasikan sistem pengamatan untuk koordinasi medan tempur, menangkap dinamika garis depan secara langsung, dan meneruskan informasi penandaan yang presisi ke Monsoon Squad dan Squad 404.)

column1: (Squad 404 will undertake the assault mission, carrying out targeted strikes against the enemy's high-value heavy firepower units, forcing the enemy to retract their frontline to protect their heavy firepower units.)
column2: (Squad 404 mengemban misi serbuan, melancarkan serangan terarah pada unit daya tembak berat musuh yang bernilai tinggi, memaksa musuh menarik garis depannya untuk melindungi unit-unit tersebut.)

column1: (Meanwhile, Monsoon Squad will utilize the characteristics of guerrilla warfare, taking advantage of the Dolls' innate superiority and the terrain advantage of fighting on home turf, to engage in brutal urban combat and slaughter with enemies entering the built-up areas.)
column2: (Sementara itu, Monsoon Squad memanfaatkan ciri khas perang gerilya, mengandalkan keunggulan bawaan para Doll dan keuntungan medan kandang, untuk bertempur kota secara brutal melawan musuh yang masuk ke kawasan padat bangunan.)

column1: (The bottom line of all operations is to absolutely ensure the Dome and the entrances to Mokosh's underground remain in our hands. On this basis, all firepower projection must precisely cut into the enemy's soft spots, infinitely amplifying their perception of being 'bogged down in a quagmire'.)
column2: (Batas mutlak semua operasi adalah memastikan Dome dan pintu masuk bawah tanah Mokosh tetap di tangan kami. Di atas dasar itu, semua pengerahan daya tembak harus mengiris tepat titik lemah musuh, melipatgandakan tanpa henti perasaan mereka bahwa mereka 'terperosok ke rawa'.)

column1: (Although Vasily constructed a large number of preset fortifications early on as strategic depth, with an eye on the upcoming bitter war of attrition, these damaged covers absolutely must not be easily abandoned. We must organize forces to repair them as quickly as possible and reintegrate them into the defensive network.)
column2: (Meski Vasily sudah lebih dulu membangun banyak benteng siap pakai sebagai kedalaman strategis, mengingat perang gesekan pahit yang akan datang, perlindungan yang rusak itu sama sekali tidak boleh ditinggalkan begitu saja. Kami harus mengerahkan tenaga untuk memperbaikinya secepat mungkin dan mengembalikannya ke jaringan pertahanan.)

column1: (This abnormal advance speed made me suspect whether the conjectured entity had already stepped onto this battlefield. I sent a message to Cheyanne and simultaneously issued orders to the Monsoon Squad.)
column2: (Kecepatan maju yang tidak wajar ini membuatku curiga jangan-jangan sosok yang kuduga itu sudah menginjak medan tempur ini. Kukirim pesan ke Cheyanne sekaligus kuturunkan perintah ke Monsoon Squad.)

column1: (Cheyanne, who had grasped the overall situation through the observation system, already knew the predicament of the Oathguards at this time, and immediately used the weapon in her hands to provide precise support.)
column2: (Cheyanne, yang sudah menguasai gambaran menyeluruh lewat sistem pengamatan, saat itu sudah tahu kesulitan yang dialami Oathguards, dan langsung memakai senjata di tangannya untuk memberi bantuan presisi.)

column1: (Five consecutive bullets successfully hit the enemy leader's body, but it only slightly slowed down the enemy's advance. However, this was enough to buy time.)
column2: (Lima peluru beruntun berhasil mengenai tubuh pemimpin musuh, tapi itu hanya sedikit memperlambat lajunya. Meski begitu, itu cukup untuk mengulur waktu.)
